task.title: Delete a recipe from the Recipe Book
task.description:
There is no way to remove a recipe from the Recipe Book. Reported from phone testing on the dev site (2026-11-18).

Wanted: a delete action on a recipe (book list and recipe page), with a confirmation.

Notes:
- recipes already carry a deletedAt field and the planner skips deleted recipes when matching names, but convex/recipes.ts has no delete mutation.
- Decide what happens to planner slots and grocery lists that point at a deleted recipe (suggest: slot keeps the name but loses the link).
- Needed to clean up the stray bare recipes the planner created; see the story on choosing a recipe in a Cook slot.
